name: claw-kit
description: Cindy workflow tools, lifecycle recovery, and Skills for claw-kit.
whenToUse: Use for Cindy sessions that need claw-kit plan, task, subplan, or workflow operations.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the available claw-kit workflow operations. Omit category for an overview, or pass a category to see operation names, descriptions, and argument schemas.

category.description: Optional operation category returned by a previous overview.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run one claw-kit workflow operation in the current Cindy session. Use a name returned by list_tools and pass only that operation's JSON arguments; Cindy supplies the session and workspace identity.

items.name: using-claw-kit
items.description: Use claw-kit through Cindy Ghost tools: recover the injected workflow snapshot, advance one plan task at a time, and keep Cindy-specific execution details out of the Agent prompt.
